notes: Required for 96-bit silicon UID. **K8 = 64 KB flash** — deferred OTA-over-RS-485 needs a bootloader + A/B app slots; no dual-bank on G0; the superseded 32 KB K6T6 had no headroom. Same LQFP-32 package/pinout. Use the official KiCad symbol (MCU_ST_STM32G0:STM32G030K8Tx).
**SOIC-16 narrow** — both TPL7407L (C383290) and ULN2003A (C2358) ship in 150 mil narrow SOIC. NOT SOIC-16W (300 mil) — pads will not bridge the IC's leads.

**PRIMARY: LM2937IMP-3.3** — 26 V operating / 60 V transient; chosen so D4 SMAJ13A's VC max 21.5 V stays inside the LDO rating. **Pinout LOCKED (LM1117 family convention): pin 1 = GND, pin 2 = VOUT (= tab), pin 3 = VIN.** Dissipation at 55 mA = 0.48 W; SOT-223 with copper pour on the **VOUT (tab/pin 2)** for heatsinking — NOT on GND. **Alternate: ST LDL1117S33TR (C434348)** — 18 V op max / 20 V abs max, same SOT-223, same pinout convention; demoted from primary because the superseded SMAJ15A's VC 24.4 V exceeded its 20 V abs max. Do NOT substitute HT7833 / AMS1117 / MCP1825 — wrong VIN ratings (HT7833 is 6.5 V max VIN, destroyed at 12 V).

**THVD1410 (D/SOIC-8) locked 2026-07-09 (#179)** — 3–5.5 V supply, 500 kbps slew-limited, true idle/open/short failsafe, ±18 kV IEC contact on bus pins. Same SOIC-8 pinout as the superseded SN65HVD75. Deletes the SM712 ESD array (former D5) and the master-side failsafe bias. Bench/production stock: Mouser 595-THVD1410DR.

3-pin header for external hall module on flying lead. **Pinout LOCKED: pin 1 = +3V3, pin 2 = GND, pin 3 = HALL_OUT** (KY-003 native order — v1 cable plugs straight in). Sensor positioned by chassis bracket relative to flap drum magnet. **Sensor: 3.3 V-capable open-drain hall required** (TI DRV5023 / Diodes AH3366Q / Honeywell SS361RT on a KY-003-style 3-wire lead) — genuine KY-003 uses an A3144 (4.5 V min supply), NOT qualified at 3.3 V; v1 modules must be bench-verified or replaced.
VGS rated only ±12 V — at 12 V brick the gate-source margin is zero. Z1 10 V Zener clamp REQUIRED to keep AO3401 in spec under brick tolerance + transients.

Q1 VGS clamp — cathode → source (PCB-12V), anode → gate node. **10 V (not 12 V)** to give margin against AO3401A's ±12 V VGS abs-max under Zener tolerance (BZT52C12 +10% = 13.2 V puts the FET out of spec). Cross-validated by Gemini + ChatGPT external review 2026-04-26.
Q1 gate series resistor (slows turn-on; isolates Z1 clamp current)

Per-unit input polyfuse in series: 12V card-edge finger → F_unit → Q1 → PCB-12V rail. A shorted unit no longer takes down its whole row, and self-identifies (its LEDs go dark). **Sizing under review (#180)** — resize after the #101 measurement on rev A (likely 0.75–1 A hold in 1812).

Unidirectional, **13 V standoff** (above 12 V + 5% brick tolerance), VC max 21.5 V — coordinated with the 26 V LM2937 LDO. Supersedes SMAJ15A, whose VC 24.4 V exceeded LDL1117's 20 V abs max. **Placement LOCKED to post-Q1 (load-side PCB-12V rail)** — cathode (banded) → PCB-12V (post-Q1 source), anode → GND. Earlier doc said 'post-pogo, before Q1' which contradicted the net diagram; ChatGPT external review caught the inconsistency. Reversed orientation = forward-bias = dead short.

**Card-edge locked 2026-07-09 (#100)** — 2.54 mm pitch, 5 positions, fingers mirrored on both card faces (10 contacts): 12V, GND, A, B, spare (spare → test pad). Polarizing key slot between GND and A; **GND fingers longest (first-make)**; 1.6 mm card; bevel + hard gold (0.3–0.8 µm Au over ≥2.5 µm Ni — standard JLC gold-fingers option). Replaces the pogo-pin system (former PG1–PG4). Exact edge position/orientation set by the #100 insertion-kinematics mock-up. Mating socket lives on the backplane BOM.

Asymmetric clip; polarization is now PRIMARILY the card-edge socket key (2026-07-09) — the clip is the secondary key. No PLA (PETG min, prefer ASA/PC — #104). Bolts via 4× M3 holes at unit board (3,3) (3,77) (37,77) (37,3). One printed per unit (64 + spares). MakerWorld STL link in build notes.
To 28BYJ-48 motor — pins 1-4 = TPL7407L OUT1-OUT4 (orange/yellow/pink/blue), pin 5 = +12 V common (red wire). 5-pin avoids 64× hand-splicing the +12 V wire into the chassis harness.
12 V input bulk — 1206 required for X7R availability at 22 uF / 25 V; 0805 in this combination is effectively vaporware on JLC

DE pull-down to GND — STM32 GPIOs float as analog inputs during reset and a floating DE can jam the bus. Kept even if the THVD1410 has internal biasing (verify datasheet at capture) — an explicit 10k is deterministic.
